assumptions.slotModel: pooled stride = align16(17 + trackIndexBytes + 2*clipIndexBytes); 17 = four uint window/factor words plus byte TrackIndex
assumptions.defaultEntries: one extra pool entry per field when some value slot carries no authored value (zero struct default)
assumptions.structModel: alternative: one byte index per slot side; pool entries are whole track/clip structs
assumptions.unchanged: header, pair table, stage table, program, labels, and identity strings are unchanged by pooling
